title: The Glint Primer
summary: A first primer on drawing a bead of light from the palm and throwing it; it teaches the sparks and flashes every light student starts with.

title: A Handbook of Steady Radiance
summary: A handbook on holding one light at a fixed brightness for a long time so that output stays even and costs little qi.

title: The Dawnbreath Workbook
summary: A workbook on slow breathing that gathers pale light qi into the chest and warms the limbs before a day of drill.

title: Course of the Open Eye
summary: A course in light gathered at the eyes that sharpens sight in the dim and marks small movements a plain eye would miss.

title: The Prism Fingers Drill
summary: A drill in splitting one thin light into many with the fingers so that a single throw stings in several places.

title: The Mending Glow Primer
summary: A primer on warm light laid on a hurt body to ease pain and close small wounds; the first healing course of the light student.

title: Exercises of the Quick Ray
summary: Exercises in the speed of light kept small: fast throws and quick steps that borrow the pace of a ray.

title: The Shining Guard Workbook
summary: A workbook on guards made of light that turn weak blows aside and blind a striker for the space of one breath.
